terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1.title: 1. Introduction
terms.s1.body: Welcome to Examio. By accessing and using our platform, you agree to comply with the terms and conditions set out in this document.
terms.s2.title: 2. User Accounts
terms.s2.body: You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure. Examio is not liable for any unauthorised activity that occurs through your account.
terms.s3.title: 3. User Content
terms.s3.body: Documents you upload to Examio remain your property. We only use that content to provide services (quiz generation, flashcards, AI chat) and do not share it with third parties.
terms.s4.title: 4. Acceptable Use
terms.s4.body: You agree not to use the platform for exam fraud, copyright infringement, or any other illegal activity.
terms.s5.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
terms.s5.body: Examio provides services "as is". We do not guarantee that AI-generated content is completely accurate. Users should verify important information.
terms.s6.title: 6. Changes to Terms
terms.s6.body: We reserve the right to update these terms. Significant changes will be communicated via email or platform notifications.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1.title: 1. Information We Collect
privacy.s1.body: When you register an account, we collect: username, email, and device information (for session management). Documents you upload are stored securely and only used to provide the service.
privacy.s2.title: 2. How We Use Information
privacy.s2.body: Your information is used to: provide and improve the service, send important notifications, and provide technical support. We do not sell personal information to third parties.
privacy.s3.title: 3. Storage & Security
privacy.s3.body: Data is stored on cloud infrastructure with encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest. User documents are stored on Cloudflare R2 with strict access control.
privacy.s4.title: 4. Your Rights
privacy.s4.body: You have the right to: access your personal data, request deletion of your account and all related data, and withdraw consent at any time by contacting us.
privacy.s5.title: 5. Sharing with Third Parties
privacy.s5.body: We only share data with necessary service providers (hosting, AI model providers) under confidentiality agreements. No data is sold or used for advertising.
privacy.s6.title: 6. Contact
privacy.s6.body: If you have questions about privacy, please contact us via email: togiap.dev@gmail.com
cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.s1.title: 1. What Are Cookies?
cookies.s1.body: Cookies are small files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the website remember information about your visit.
cookies.s2.title: 2. Cookies We Use
cookies.s2.body: Examio uses essential cookies for: maintaining login sessions, remembering interface preferences (dark/light mode, language), and security (CSRF token). We do not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies.
cookies.s3.title: 3. Third-Party Cookies
cookies.s3.body: We use Cloudflare Turnstile to protect registration/login forms. This service may set its own cookies according to Cloudflare's policy.
cookies.s4.title: 4. Managing Cookies
cookies.s4.body: You can delete or block cookies through your browser settings. Note that blocking essential cookies may affect your experience on the platform.
security.title: Security Policy
security.s1.title: 1. Data Encryption
security.s1.body: All data transmitted between the browser and server is encrypted using TLS 1.3. Documents stored on Cloudflare R2 are encrypted at rest.
security.s2.title: 2. Authentication & Sessions
security.s2.body: Examio uses short-lived JWT tokens combined with device management (device tracking) to detect unusual access. Login sessions can be revoked remotely.
security.s3.title: 3. Document Protection
security.s3.body: Documents you upload are only accessible by your account. No other users or staff can view document content without explicit permission.
security.s4.title: 4. AI & Data
security.s4.body: Document content is processed by AI to generate quizzes and flashcards. This data is not used to train AI models and is not shared between users.
security.s5.title: 5. Reporting Vulnerabilities
security.s5.body: If you discover a security vulnerability, please contact us immediately at: togiap.dev@gmail.com. We commit to responding within 48 hours.
